annotations.title: Recommend what to monitor for a website

description: Use this when the user asks what they should monitor for a website, what could take their site down, or which third-party services (hosting, CDN, DNS, payments, email, analytics) a site depends on, and when someone with no FlareWarden account asks what monitoring a site would get before signing up. Reads the site's DNS records, home page and certificate and checks it from six regions. Returns the services it recognizes with the evidence for each and their status now, the certificate's expiry, a DNS summary, whether the site is up now, the page checks that would work on it, and what FlareWarden would create and how many monitors that is, on each FlareWarden plan. Needs no sign-in and stores nothing about the user; results are cached per site for a day. Not for whether a site is up right now on its own: use check_service_status_url. Not for creating monitoring: once the user is signed in, the account tools plan and create it. What it detects is documented at https://flarewarden.com/docs/smart-setup.
